# Redis: stats

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To retrieve Redis database statistics, send a GET request to the /v1/bdbs/stats endpoint with SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the specific database identifier. The response returns SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the stats object shape containing SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the number of stats entries. Agents must include SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the authorization header value.

Search intents:
- redis stats endpoint parameters
- redis rest api stats
- redis database monitoring stats

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/redis-stats --json
